name: Magic by the Kilowatt
source:
n the two years since she moved to Savannah, Lana Spark has felt disconnected from the world around her. Plagued by memories of her past, she has survived most of high school being a wallflower. Now in her senior year, her once-buried passions resurface when she discovers that her little sister Audrey is living out their shared childhood fantasy: protecting the world from monsters as a magical girl! Lana transforms to fight alongside her sister and friends, forming a band of heavenly protectors known as 'Angels'. Tasked with defending Earth from the invasion of the Cog Kingdom, the girls will find that being a magical girl isn’t just about living out past passions, but confronting past traumas as well.

[From [url=https://cure-hikari.itch.io/magikilo-demo] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搬到萨凡纳后的两年里，拉娜·斯帕克始终觉得自己与周围世界格格不入。过去的记忆不断纠缠，她在高中大部分时间都像个不起眼的旁观者。如今升入高年级，当她发现妹妹奥黛丽正在实现两人童年共同的幻想——作为魔法少女保护世界免受怪物侵袭——时，埋藏已久的热情再次浮现。拉娜变身，与妹妹和朋友并肩作战，组成名为“天使”的守护者团队。女孩们肩负起保卫地球、抵御齿轮王国入侵的任务，也将发现，成为魔法少女不只是重拾过去的热情，更要直面过去的创伤。
